verdict.rationale: Warp's built-in Agent Mode plans and executes tasks (writing code, running commands, debugging, multi-step task execution) with approval-based interaction and follow-up/queueing controls, well documented across docs-6, docs-44, docs-13/15/45. Community evidence corroborates real usage of AI-generated commands and agent workflows (warp-comm-8, warp-comm-9), though some report occasional agent reliability issues (warp-comm-11) which is a minor caveat rather than a contradiction of the core capability. Missing for 10: independent, rigorous verification of the approval/confirmation UX specifically (evidence shows queueing/follow-up but not an explicit 'approve before execution' step), and reports of agent reliability issues add slight quality deduction.
